Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Trait. Please note that these abilities are incredibly powerful even for the JJK system and should only be used for purposely high power games. Of course, certain traits are stronger than others. Stages of these traits have been added to grow with characters with higher levels of play. Dormant, Stirring, and Awakened. Though a DM can decide to change the leveling format or instead give them out at appropriate character moments.

Mutual Union. Your Vengeful Spirit adds your proficiency bonus to its AC. As a reaction, you can spend 1 cursed energy to add your proficiency bonus to a saving throw your Vengeful Spirit makes.

Vengeful Love. When the Vengeful Spirit uses its Grudge feature, it gains a +1 to critical range for 1 minute against the creature that made it use that feature, stacking if used against the same creature. If the Vengeful Spirit is killed, you gain a +2 bonus to critical range against the creature that killed it for 1 minute.

Basic Cursed Energy Manipulation. Your Vengeful Spirit gains access to Cursed Strike and Cursesight, but does not gain the benefits of any Awakened Understanding you unlock.

Special Trait tiers stack: keep the earlier tiers on the sheet. When a benefit says it replaces an earlier one, the module's effects already account for it.
